sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: an open-source AI coding agent used in VS Code, JetBrains, CLI, and cloud, with 500+ models, BYOK, and local models (`claim-kilo-code-sf-what-it-is`, `claim-kilo-code-sf-identity`)
- What it is not: not a standalone desktop IDE (`claim-kilo-code-sf-what-it-is-not-standalone-ide`). iOS is not a shipped store client (`claim-kilo-code-sf-what-it-is-not-ios`, `claim-kilo-code-sf-not-for`). `kilo-pi-provider` is a separate candidate

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: `runtime` (`claim-kilo-code-sf-primary-type`)
- Secondary roles: `ide` for editor plugins (`claim-kilo-code-sf-secondary-role-ide`); `cloud-agent` for Cloud Agents (`claim-kilo-code-sf-secondary-role-cloud-agent`); `general-agent` for KiloClaw (`claim-kilo-code-sf-secondary-role-general-agent`)
- Agent-loop owner: CLI uses the same underlying technology as the IDE extensions (`claim-kilo-code-sf-agent-loop-owner`); Cloud Agents run that coding agent in a vendor container (`claim-kilo-code-sf-agent-loop-owner-cloud`); KiloClaw is hosted OpenClaw powered by Kilo Code (`claim-kilo-code-sf-agent-loop-owner-kiloclaw`)
- Architecture: current VS Code extension is built on the CLI (`claim-kilo-code-sf-architecture`); CLI config lives in `~/.config/kilo/` and project `.kilo/` (`claim-kilo-code-sf-architecture-cli-config`); CLI is an OpenCode fork on the CLI docs, not the installing page (`claim-kilo-code-sf-lineage-cli-opencode`); JetBrains is a native non-ACP plugin (`claim-kilo-code-sf-surface-jetbrains`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-kilo-code-vscode`, `surface-kilo-code-jetbrains`, `surface-kilo-code-cli`, `surface-kilo-code-cloud-web`, `surface-kilo-code-slack`, `surface-kilo-code-android`, `surface-kilo-code-acp`, `surface-kilo-code-remote-relay`, `surface-kilo-code-code-reviewer`, `surface-kilo-code-kiloclaw`, `surface-kilo-code-kiloclaw-telegram`, `surface-kilo-code-kiloclaw-discord`, `surface-kilo-code-kiloclaw-slack`, `surface-kilo-code-gateway-api`
- Execution location: same-device VS Code files and terminal (`claim-kilo-code-sf-execution-local`); same-device default CLI (`claim-kilo-code-sf-execution-local-cli`); vendor-cloud Cloud Agent container (`claim-kilo-code-sf-execution-cloud`); hosted Code Reviewer (`claim-kilo-code-sf-execution-cloud-reviewer`); KiloClaw dedicated instance (`claim-kilo-code-sf-execution-cloud-kiloclaw`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: homepage 500+ models, Auto Model tiers, BYOK, local models, no silent switching (`claim-kilo-code-sf-model-strategy`); mid-task switching on the README (`claim-kilo-code-sf-tag-model-switching`); named local providers Ollama, LM Studio, and Atomic Chat (`claim-kilo-code-sf-model-strategy-local-providers`)
- Auth strategy: Kilo account (email, Google, Apple, GitHub, GitLab, Discord, LinkedIn, Anaconda, or SSO) plus optional provider keys and ChatGPT Plus/Pro reuse (`claim-kilo-code-sf-auth-strategy`)
- Provider support: 30+ direct providers plus the Kilo Gateway catalog (`claim-kilo-code-sf-provider-support`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: MIT-licensed multi-surface agent with 500+ models at provider rates plus first-party cloud, Slack, reviewer, and hosted OpenClaw (`claim-kilo-code-sf-unique-value`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: Cloud YOLO, no Cloud MCP, 15-minute cloud message cap, 7-day inactive deletion (`claim-kilo-code-sf-drawback`); deprecated Orchestrator (`claim-kilo-code-sf-drawback-orchestrator`); deprecated Console (`claim-kilo-code-sf-drawback-console`); remote-mode account risk (`claim-kilo-code-sf-security-remote-mode`)

- Not-for: standalone-IDE users (`claim-kilo-code-sf-what-it-is-not-standalone-ide`); shipped iOS (`claim-kilo-code-sf-not-for`); Cloud MCP (`claim-kilo-code-sf-mcp-cloud`). Slack+GitLab remains unknown
